# `foxglove layouts get`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](layouts.md)

Usage: foxglove layouts get [OPTIONS] <LAYOUT_ID>

Arguments:
  <LAYOUT_ID>


Options:

      --format <FORMAT>

      --config <CONFIG>
